summary: Iteration 2 covers the new PATCH /api/auth/me edit-profile endpoint + UI and the widened Cookist chat (maxHeight 220 -> 420). Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (100%), including 4 new tests around PATCH /auth/me — happy-path display_name update, owner_name recipe sync, empty-name 400, avatar-only update, and auth-required guard. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Edit-profile happy path verified end-to-end — cook@owami.app -> Profile tab -> row-edit -> screen renders with all required testIDs (edit-back, edit-save, edit-name-input, edit-avatar-library, edit-avatar-camera), name pre-filled with 'Cookist', 'Choose photo' & 'Take photo' visible, email is a read-only field with a lock icon and support hint. Renamed to 'Chef Ada' -> Save -> profile header updated to 'Chef Ada'. Restored to 'Cookist' at end. Empty-name save shows 'Please add your name' inline error. Cookist chat: premium@owami.app -> first recipe -> Start Cooking -> sent 3 different messages sequentially -> all 3 user bubbles (cookist-msg-user-0..2) and all 3 Owami reply bubbles (cookist-msg-owami-1,3,5) are present. Chat container computed style: maxHeight=420px, minHeight=120px (matches spec). Earliest message ('how much salt') remains reachable via scrollUp. All Gemini AI replies returned within ~6s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_me correctly guards empty display_name (400) and cascades display_name into recipes.owner_name via update_many — good.
profile/edit.tsx handles both display_name-only and avatar-only PATCH via api.updateMe; useAuth.refresh() is awaited before router.back() so Profile header re-renders with fresh user — good.
TextInput has maxLength=40 which caps name — acceptable UX guard.
cookist chat maxHeight: 420, minHeight: 120 confirmed in styles (line 256).

Note: server.py still around 750 lines. Not a regression but same soft-cap comment from iteration_1 applies. No react-native deprecation issues found in this iteration's diff (no new expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner usage).
